name: public_service_area_geoms
title: Electric Service Areas of Alaska (Individual Geometries)
description: Electric service area boundaries broken into individual polygon features per physical territory.

resources.name: public_service_area_geoms
resources.title: Electric Service Areas of Alaska (Individual Geometries)
resources.description: Spatial file of electric service area polygons in Alaska, used in AEDG (Alaska Energy Data Gateway) to associate communities with infrastructure and sales reporting. Non-contiguous service boundaries assigned to a single utility CPCN are split into separate feature records.

context.title: Alaska Energy Data Gateway v3.0
context.publisher: Alaska Center for Energy and Power (ACEP) at the University of Alaska Fairbanks (UAF)

sources.title: ACEP Electric Service Areas
authors: Alaska Center for Energy and Power (ACEP)
sources.description: The Regulatory Commission of Alaska (RCA) associates every regulated electric utility with a service area in which they are allowed to operate. Using the individual service area files provided by the RCA, the Alaska Center for Energy and Power (ACEP) assembled a single geospatial file in GeoJSON format which contains the service area boundaries of every active electric utility in Alaska. AEDG uses these service area polygons to identify the utility/utilities serving each community across the state.
